page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c16g1.4xlarge is an accelerated virtual instance within the Compute Optimized with GPU family. It couples dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B compute resources with hardware acceleration from NVIDIA. The instance allocates 16 vCPUs derived from 8 physical cores running at a base clock frequency of 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, supported by 48 MB of L3 cache and vector extensions including AVX-512 and VNNI. System memory measures 60.0 GiB, providing 3.75 GiB per vCPU.

Hardware acceleration is driven by an onboard NVIDIA A10 GPU built on the Ampere architecture, equipped with 24 GiB of dedicated VRAM. The instance does not include local ephemeral storage, relying entirely on network-attached storage options, and features a baseline network throughput of 16 Gbps. Standard benchmarks position general compute, memory bandwidth, and decompression workloads within the middle tier, with a PassMark CPU score of 21,025.87 and Geekbench multi-core score of 9,350.0.

In AI model deployment benchmarks, the Ampere-based accelerator registers top-tier inference speeds for small to medium models. Text generation reaches 460.73 tokens per second on a 135M parameter model and 90.39 tokens per second on a 7B parameter model, with prompt processing exceeding 2,480 tokens per second for 7B parameters. The 24 GiB VRAM footprint imposes a constraint on hosting larger architectures such as 70B parameter models without distributed parallelism or extreme quantization.

The ecs.gn7i-c16g1.4xlarge provides a balanced hardware cost-efficiency profile for accelerated computing, avoiding the higher resource premiums of flagship training accelerators. It is technically appropriate for mid-scale deep learning inference, real-time computer vision, AI-assisted video transcoding, and GPU-accelerated graphics rendering or virtual workstations.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c16g1.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance featuring 16 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz, 60.0 GiB of RAM, and a single NVIDIA A10 GPU with 24 GiB of VRAM. Operating over the x86_64 architecture with 16 Gbps baseline network bandwidth and no integrated local storage, this instance is tailored for accelerated processing tasks. Standard benchmarks report balanced general-purpose CPU and memory throughput, while deep learning evaluations showcase top-tier performance for small- to mid-scale inference, clocking over 90 tokens per second during 7B model text generation. The 24 GiB VRAM configuration makes it cost-efficient for specialized workloads that do not demand large cluster allocations, such as AI model serving, real-time video processing, graphics virtualization, and machine learning inference pipelines.
